notes.title: Quality of life update - Changelog 2025-03-20
notes.content:
Dear players,

We've released a big quality-of-life update of Dawnmaker at the end of last week, and a minor update with bug fixes today. Here are the major changes these updates bring:

 Added an option, when picking a character, to enable infinite retries. This option allows you to replay regions you lost as many times as you like, and prevents losing a run.
 Reworked a bunch of interfaces (as part of our work on the mobile version). For example, the Character selection screen has been completely revamped, and buildings in the market are now in a separate column and with miniatures instead of the full card.
 Enabled the Steam Overlay.
 And a bunch of small bug fixes!

As usual, we thank you for playing Dawnmaker! We hope we'll keep receiving your feedback, either on the Steam forums, on our Discord server, or via the F8 key in the game. 

On to the changelog!

Gameplay

 [bug] Made sure the Recycling house will not stop triggering when activating adjacent buildings.
 Made the first draft after each Aerostation level up offer Eclairium-producing buildings.
 Added an option, when picking a character, to enable infinite retries. This option allows you to replay regions you lost as many times as you like, and prevents losing a run.
 [bug] Prevented unlocking the third character when finishing the tutorial.
 [bug] Prevented having the same wonder as a reward for multiple regions.

Quality of life

 Moved the market into a separate column to the right of the screen.
 Changed how buildings look in the market, to show them with a bigger illustration and name but no rules or types.
 Reworked the Character selection screen to make it prettier and better organized.
 [bug] Fixed the wrong font being used for character names in the Character selection screen.
 Reworked the Settings screen and made it accessible via a button from everywhere in the game.
 Made your hand be highlighted when targeting a card.
 Added a counter in the tooltip of buildings that care about the number of cards played during a turn.
 Added a setting to change the font size.
 Enabled the Steam Overlay.
 [bug] Hiding a modal only hides the latest opened one instead of all the modals.
 Added buttons to buy buildings and cards in the Airship.
 Moved the "No building" button when drafting a building to the bottom bar.
 [bug] Prevented activating the main action when pressing Enter while a modal is open.

Content

 Updated the rules of the Automated field building to make it clearer that it always adds 1 🌱 even if there are no adjacent fields.

notes.title: The Characters Major Update
notes.content:
Dear players,

We are proud to announce that we have just released a major update of Dawnmaker, including the long-awaited undo button, a whole lot of new content, and… characters! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830837/78a5262ead97ba6243de67338f1dd295f9f002c3.gif

Start a new game of Dawnmaker today and meet Sibille, Cassian and Théa. Each has a specific starting deck and starting roster of buildings, as well as a difficulty indicator. Sibille is the one you know if you've played the game already: she likes fields and wonders. Cassian is more of science guy: he likes activation buildings and spending science to generate luminoil. Théa has a passion for harvesting and… destroying buildings! She's the hardest to play with and should present a nice challenge for those looking for increased difficulty. 

Special offer!

To celebrate the launch of this major update, we are discounting Dawnmaker for the first time! Buy the game during the next 2 weeks and save 20% off its cost. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2749100/Dawnmaker/

We hope you'll enjoy this new content! As usual, let us know what you think about Dawnmaker here on Steam's forum, by pressing the F8 key anywhere in the game, or in our Discord server. We're looking forward to your feedback. 

And now, on to our longest changelog yet…

Changelog for the Characters Update - 2024-10-07

Gameplay
Added 2 new characters with their unique starting deck and roster. Choose the character you want to play with at the start of a run. Win a game with one of the two first characters to unlock the third one!Added buttons to refresh the buildings or cards in the Airship market. You can refresh each content once per region, for a cost of 5 gold.Fixed activations of the Aerostation, Ruins and Shipwrecks not triggering adjacent "on activation" effects.Put more ruins in early regions to allow for more opportunities to discover buildings.

Quality of life
Added an undo button! You can roll back all the way to the last action that revealed new information, by pressing the button in the bottom left corner or by hitting Ctrl + Z. Actions revealing new information or including some randomness cannot be undone: drawing cards, refreshing the market, exploring a ruin or a shipwreck, etc. Added a dialog to confirm that you want to start a new game when you already have one going.Improved text rendering for cards with long rules.

notes.title: MacOS and many improvements - Changelog 2024-08-09
notes.content:
Dear players,

First we want to address our warmest thank you to all of you for the incredible reception you gave Dawnmaker! We've received a ton of great feedback about what you liked and what was frustrating to you, and this is really heartwarming. We've spent 2.5 years of our lives working on this title, finally seeing people from far away or close by playing the game and enjoying it is the best feeling. ❤️

On to today's update: we're very happy to announce that Dawnmaker is now available on MacOS! We hope Apple enthusiasts will enjoy playing on their favorite computer. Let us know if you have any problems with the game!

As I mentioned, we also received a lof of feedback about what was frustrating in Dawnmaker. Today we're releasing a first update that addresses many of these frustrations. Check the full changelog for a comprehensive list of what we changed.

Changelog for version 2024.07.29

Gameplay

 Added a link to another region from the first region. Losing the 2nd region won't mean the end of the run anymore.
 Added wonders as a reward for 3 regions.

Quality of life

 Added a new FX around the aerostation when it can be activated to win.
 Added an option to switch from fullscreen to windowed.
 Made the Airship tab be open by default after securing a region.
 Added a delay after the end turn button becomes usable again, to avoid accidental double-clicking.
 [bug] Made sure that buildings are sorted by level in the buildings roster view.
 [bug] Fixed a missing translation when exploring a ruin.

Content

 The Aerostation does not require action points to be activated to win anymore.


Thank you for playing Dawnmaker! We hope we'll keep receiving your feedback, either on the Steam forums, on our Discord server, or via the F8 key in the game. It is very precious as it helps us improve the game and make it the best experience for you. 👍️

Subscribe to our newsletter to receive the latest stories about Dawnmaker’s development

notes.title: Changelog 2024-07-29 - Japanese available and a playtest on Steam
notes.content:
Dear players,

We are very excited to announce that Dawnmaker will be available in Japanese on its release day, July 31st! It will come alongside the English and French translations. Japanese is already available in the demo: play it now. ;)

We've also just shipped one last update before the release, with a big gameplay change, shiny new frames for the cards, bug fixes and some minor balancing on the content. And we're using this opportunity to start a playtest of the full game, open to anyone and everyone starting… now! The playtest will be open for about 24 hours, so if you want to give it a go before the release, and help us make sure there are no bugs in the game, now is your time. 

To playtest the game, go to the store page of Dawnmaker, and click "Request access" in the playtest box. That's it, you'll then get to play the game as much as you like for the next 24 hours. Let us know what you think about the game here, in our Discord server or by pressing F8 anywhere in the game!

Now, on to the full changelog, and we'll see you again in 2 days for the full release of Dawnmaker. :)

Changelog for version 2024.07.29

Gameplay

 Locked some buildings. They cannot appear in the building draft until you have found them in a ruin or bought them in the airship.

Quality of life

 Added new frames for all the cards! So shiny! 
 Added an icon next to the "gain" keyword on all buildings that have it.
 Made it harder to lose in the tutorial.
 Showed the Luminoil output preview on the Abundant reaping card.
 [bug] Building tooltips cannot appear outside of the screen anymore.
 [bug] Disabled cards zooming when hover while playing a building.
 [bug] Fixed the map becoming misplaced when zooming out too much.

Content

 Added a Japanese localization of the game.

notes.title: Changelog 2024-07-02 - Maps and Collection
notes.content:
What's up players? 

We are happy to bring you a new update of Dawnmaker's demo, this time containing 2 new features and a bunch of balance changes. The big features this time are Maps — each region has its own, unique landscape with mountains, lakes and rivers — and Collection — keep track of the buildings you have unlocked throughout your games.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830837/66b4cca1e04c4bcfb369d4bc96a5d2b1737bf9c5.gif

We hope you'll enjoy these changes. Let us know what you think here, in our Discord server or by pressing F8 anywhere in the game!

Oh and… We have a big announcement coming up this Friday, so, stay tuned? You can follow us on social media — Twitter, Instagram, Tiktok or Youtube — or subscribe to our newsletter.

And now, on to the full changelog…

Changelog for version 2024.07.02

Gameplay

Added mountain, lake, river and sea tiles on the maps. They cannot be constructed on. Each region has its own map. 
Added a Collection view, where you can see all the buildings you've unlocked in the game. Gotta catch 'em all! 

Quality of life

Made cards and building show an effect when giving action points.

notes.title: World Map Update - New Demo for Steam Next Fest
notes.content:
Dear players,

We are very excited to release a new version of Dawnmaker's demo today! Come and get a glimpse of the World Map feature, where you can travel the lost continent of Heksiga and repel the Smog, region by region. You'll also get to improve your starting deck, roster and resources in the new Airship menu. More replayability, more choices, more strategy… We hope you'll like it! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830837/714f04ef9ccc478fe82023c4a0d725036529448f.gif

Today's other big news is that we'll be participating in Steam Next Fest starting on Monday. Be sure to give the demo another try, and share it with your friends, to help us get the word out! We're a small team of 2 people, so everything you can do to help us show Dawnmaker around has a huge impact for us. 

Thank you for being with us, we wish you great fun with this new version of the game! On to the full changelog now…

Gameplay


 Added a shortened version of the World Map (only 2 regions available). Travel from region to region, gain gold, and spend it in the Airship market to improve your starting deck, starting roster and starting resources.
 Added a new type of vestige: shipwrecks. Explore them and find out what they do! 🙂


Quality of life


 Added an interface to see the content of your current deck, full deck, starting deck and discard, while in game (click on the deck icon or discard pile).
 Improved controls to allow playing a building by clicking it then clicking the tile (along with dragging and dropping it on the tile).


Content

 Improved the world map illustrations.

notes.title: Changelog 2024-05-17 - Sound settings
notes.content:
Dear players,

Today we are releasing a fairly small update, but containing a much-requested feature: sound effects volume setting! But there are a few quality of life improvements as well, details follow. Hope you enjoy this new version of Dawnmaker!

Not included in the demo, we are making good progress on the meta-progression of the game, the feature is nearly complete and we are doing playtests with players in our discord and newsletter. If you’re interested to be included in our next playtests, be sure to subscribe to our newsletter!

Changelog for version 2024.05.17

Gameplay


 Lighthouses now repel the Smog when they are repaired, allowing for a little bit more space.


Quality of life


 Allow setting the volume of sound effects in settings.
 Save sound settings between sessions.
 Make the buildings gained FX faster when there are a lot of them.
 Allow cancelling playing a card or a building with right-click.
 Improve showing cards in hand when there are many of them (now supports up to about 15 cards in hand).
 Improve the tutorial by adding some new tooltips to explain the context of the game, the turn structure, and market controls.



As usual, we are very much looking forwards to your feedback on these changes, or on the game in general. Hit that F8 button! ;)

notes.title: Changelog 2024-04-10 - Better tutorial
notes.content:
Dear players!

We are happy to release a new version of Dawnmaker’s demo today. Based on the feedback with received from playtests, we’ve improved the overall experience of the tutorial, with the intent of making it both easier to understand and follow, and to make it a more satisfying and rewarding moment.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830837/0499ca79443d128c4f1edaa4968db9f6d3f7ef9c.gif

Here’s the breakdown of all the changes since the last release (2024-03-21):

Quality of life

     Added a feedback when you gain a new building.
     Improved the controls to play cards to allow both drag&dropping and just plain clicking a card.
     Added the number of remaining lighthouses to repair in the Eclairium tooltip.
     Added the number of remaining turns before running out in the Luminoil tooltip.

Tutorial

     Moved the tutorial goals into a more visible box, added a bunch of small effects on them.
     Added a tooltip to explain the Smog.
     Added many tooltips all around the tutorial to explain the less intuitive things.

Cosmetic

     Refactored the end game screens into a single screen.
     Added fireworks around the city when you win a game.
     Added a button to watch your city after you’ve won.
     Added a custom cursor.


As usual, we are hungry for your feedback, on those changes or on the game in general!
